reviewer_role: independent editorial review of new bilingual drafts and directions
method: Independently read the proposed bilingual drafts and the exact body_evidence source nodes / relevant PDF page windows. Rehashed every referenced source, passage, quote, and bound prior-review row. No refetch or full-paper reread claimed.
global_quality_evaluation: A separate real fixed-case evaluator run is owned by the parent task; this review neither concludes it nor substitutes for it.
publication_boundary: Editorial support only. Formal user authorization and real per-date owner PR/merge provenance are handled separately. This artifact is not an approval, merge, publication, CI, or experiment receipt.
final_binding_requirement: Use final canonical source_hash values when making review rows; package hypothetical summary hashes are not approval receipts. Direction and summary overrides must remain transparent manual fields without fabricated llm/gate provenance.

items.judgment_zh: 摘要准确描述质量/成本反馈推动候选晋升和开发评估候选保留，未错误限定为只保留 Pareto 前沿；generalize 对应 taxonomy 的准入与成本。

HF/canonical 与官方摘要货币转义不同；摘要无数值，不能因此静默改写来源；任何规范化后需重绑最终 hash。
